title: Fashion Model Photoshoot
summary: A series of fashion photographs featuring two models in various pieces, captured at the Auckland Botanical Gardens. This series uses photography as a medium to represent the creativity that went into each of these fashion pieces. Fashion clothing designed by Neve Sutherland.
blurb: Shot for Neve Sutherland's capstone fashion project. The task was to photograph the garments in a way that carried the same intent she had put into making them, so environment, pose and angle were chosen deliberately against each piece rather than applied as a single house style. The result is an artistic read of the collection rather than a straight catalogue record.
